summary: This standards-track document describes elliptic curve key exchange algorithms for TLS, in particular ephemeral ECDH key agreement and the use of ECDSA in the handshake, for TLS 1.2 and earlier. It was later replaced by RFC 9846.

eli5.summary: A way for a website and your browser to agree on a secret using clever curve math. It was later replaced by RFC 9846.

questions: how does tls use elliptic curve cryptography
